title: AI Company Anthropic Plans to Go Public—and It's Worth Almost a Trillion Dollars!
summary: Have you ever chatted with an AI like Claude to help with homework or write a story? The company that makes Claude, called Anthropic, just announced it's going to sell shares to the public—a move called an IPO (initial public offering). That means anyone could soon own a tiny piece of this giant AI company. And it is giant! In May, investors valued Anthropic at $965 billion. That's more than its rival OpenAI. Anthropic makes about $47 billion a year from people and businesses using Claude to write code, answer questions, and do other tasks. But here's the twist: even though it makes a lot of money, it spends even more. It's still losing money, like many AI companies. Some experts worry this could be a bubble—like when something gets too expensive too fast and then pops. Anthropic was started in 2021 by former OpenAI leaders. Now both companies, plus Elon Musk's SpaceX, are racing to go public. Going first could help Anthropic set the rules for how AI companies report their finances. If it joins the stock market at nearly $1 trillion, it would be one of the biggest new companies ever. That could shake up the whole market. So, would you buy a share of an AI company?
why_it_matters: If companies like Anthropic become giant public businesses, their technology could shape the tools you use at school and later at work—and anyone might get to own a piece of that future.

background_read: Anthropic (an AI company founded in 2021 by former leaders of OpenAI) created Claude, a chatbot that many students now use to help with homework and writing.
OpenAI (the company behind ChatGPT, which became famous worldwide) is Anthropic’s biggest competitor in the race to build smarter AI assistants.
Elon Musk (the billionaire founder of SpaceX and Tesla) is also part of this race with his own AI company, xAI, making the competition even fiercer.
When a company goes public, ordinary people can buy stock and own a tiny piece of it—just like they do with brands like Apple or Disney.
Article_Structure: WHO: Anthropic, the AI company that makes Claude, and its rival OpenAI.
WHAT: Anthropic announced it will launch an IPO to become a publicly traded company worth almost $1 trillion.
WHERE: The company operates globally but would list its shares on a major stock market, likely in the United States.
WHY: To raise huge sums of money and possibly be the first AI firm to set rules for how such companies report their finances.

perspectives.description: People see a chance to make money if Anthropic keeps growing, just like early investors in Apple or Amazon did.
Some experts fear the price is too high too fast and that if the AI hype disappears, many people could lose their savings.
With OpenAI, Anthropic, and Musk’s company all racing to go public, whichever moves first could gain a big advantage and shape the whole industry.
